text: Ask the graph "what can I do today?": an assistant for Commons Hub members
description: An LLM over the hub's graph that anyone can ask "what can I do today?" and that answers with a few concrete ideas fitting the person (their interests, time, what is unblocked and valuable), with the path to why each matters. It reads through the read-only MCP (af701cd6), so it cannot damage the graph; picking something up happens in the person's own git account. Related: conversational idea elicitation (0697d033) turns a person's goal into proposed ideas, the reverse direction.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: A read-only tool surface lets anyone use the assistant without write access to the graph.
